instruction: 听全部五段材料，按2题、3题、3题、3题、4题的顺序完成全部15题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听前、听后各按每题5秒留时。审阅可重播，非正式次数控制。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Is that rattling sound coming from the window?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I thought so, but it stops whenever I hold the lampshade. One of its clips must be loose.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will tighten it after I switch the lamp off.

questions.stem: What is probably making the noise?
options: A loose part of the lamp.
questions.rationale: A：女方原想法已修正；B：扶灯罩声音停止支持灯夹松；C：未开收音机

questions.stem: What will the man do first?
questions.rationale: A：不是开窗；B：不需新灯泡；C：明确拧紧之前先断灯

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I found a letter from my grandfather in this book. There is no date on it.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Does the envelope have a stamp?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No envelope, but he mentions that my mother is about to start school. She started in September nineteen eighty-two.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Then the letter must be from around that time.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes. I will keep it with the family photographs, rather than leave it in the book.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You could scan it too, so everyone in the family can read it.

options: A reference to the mother starting school.
questions.rationale: A：没有信封；B：信中说母亲将入学可推时间；C：未夹报纸

questions.stem: Where will the woman keep it?
questions.rationale: A：明确与家庭照片放一起；B：不再留书中；C：未交学校

questions.stem: What does the man also suggest?
questions.rationale: A：未邮寄原件；B：未重写；C：建议扫描便于家人读

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Could you cover my shift at the bike repair stand on Saturday?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: In the morning, yes, but I have a class at one.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That is enough. I need to collect some donated bikes at ten, and I will be back by noon.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Do I have to repair anything difficult?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. Just write down what people need. We will do the actual repairs when I return.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: All right. I will bring a notebook.

questions.stem: Why does the man need help?
questions.rationale: A：课是女方的安排；B：没有生病；C：明确十点收捐赠车
A：明确noon前回来；B：女方一点上课；C：非晚间

questions.stem: What should the woman mainly do?
questions.rationale: A：实际维修等男方回来；B：明确记录来访需要；C：不售车

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The choir sounded different today. Were there fewer singers?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The same number came, but we stood in a circle instead of rows.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Why did you change that?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: In rows, the back singers could hardly hear the front. In a circle, everyone could hear the whole group.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Will you stand like that for the concert?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Probably not; the audience needs to see us. But it is useful for practice.

questions.rationale: A：人数相同；B：没改歌词；C：由排成行改围圆
A：明确改善互听；B：未谈取暖；C：未谈椅子

questions.stem: How will the circle probably be used?
questions.rationale: A：演出顾及观众不会这样；B：明确练习有用；C：不是拍照用途

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Hello, everyone. I am the coordinator of our neighbourhood book box. It has been beside the bakery for six months. At first we only accepted novels, but many children asked for picture books, so we have added a lower shelf for them. You may borrow one book at a time, without signing a form. Please return it to the same box when you have finished. Books are not for sale. A problem recently was that people left large piles of magazines on the ground. They became wet before volunteers could collect them. From now on, please contact us before donating more than five books, and do not leave magazines at the box. We will open a second box near the swimming pool next month. Anyone who can help check that box on Monday evenings should speak to me after this meeting. We already have enough helpers for Saturdays.

questions.stem: Why was a lower shelf added?
options: To provide picture books for children.
questions.rationale: A：不收杂志；B：回应儿童想读绘本；C：图书不出售

questions.stem: How many books may someone borrow at one time?
questions.rationale: A：明确一次一本；B：五本是大批捐赠联系阈值；C：不是无限借

questions.stem: What should a person do before donating ten books?
questions.rationale: A：地上堆书会淋湿；B：第二箱未开放；C：超过五本先联系
A：周六已有足够志愿者；B：明确周一晚检查第二箱；C：没有每天早晨要求
